title: Think in Latent, Explain in Language: Self-Explainable Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.13570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent reasoning has emerged as a powerful alternative to text-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT), offering significant gains in computational efficiency by compressing verbose reasoning into compact embeddings. However, compressing reasoning into the latent space renders the thinking opaque, hindering its interpretability. Current methods present a stark trade-off: they either function as unexplainable ''black boxes'' (e.g., Coconut), where the latent reasoning is not human-readable, or rely on separate post-hoc decoders for explainability (e.g., Heima), introducing architectural overhead and decoupling the explanation from the actual reasoning process. In this work, we present a unified framework for Self-Explainable Latent Reasoning (SELR) that trains a single model to perform efficient and inherently explainable latent reasoning. translated_title: 在潜在空间中思考，以语言进行解释：自解释的潜在推理
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13570v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：潜在推理已成为基于文本的思维链（CoT）的一种强大替代方案，通过将冗长的推理压缩为紧凑的嵌入，在计算效率上实现了显著提升。然而，将推理压缩到潜在空间会使思考过程变得不透明，阻碍了其可解释性。当前方法呈现出一种明显的权衡：它们要么作为无法解释的“黑箱”（例如，Coconut），其中潜在推理不可人类阅读，要么依赖单独的后处理解码器来实现可解释性（例如，Heima），这引入了架构开销，并使解释与实际推理过程脱节。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个用于自解释潜在推理（SELR）的统一框架，该框架训练单一模型以执行高效且本质上可解释的潜在推理。我们的核心贡献是一种新颖的多任务训练目标，该目标同时优化两个目标：（1）高效地执行潜在推理，（2）生成与推理过程对齐的自然语言解释，从而在不牺牲效率或增加额外架构的情况下实现透明性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自解释潜在推理框架（SELR），通过单一模型同时实现高效潜在推理和可解释的语言解释，解决了现有方法在可解释性与效率之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Self-Explainable Latent Reasoning (SELR) framework that enables a single model to perform efficient latent reasoning while generating interpretable language explanations, addressing the trade-off between explainability and efficiency in existing methods.
